stories.title: Djokovic Extends Beijing Record to 30-0 — First Win Since Wimbledon

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
Djokovic wins in Beijing. 🎾

First match since Wimbledon. Result: 6-3, 7-6(2) over Borges.

Record in Beijing: 30-0. Six titles.

He took a medical timeout in the second set. He won the tiebreak 7-2. #ChinaOpen #Djokovic

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Djokovic hasn't played a tour match since Wimbledon QF on July 7.

Today he walked out in Beijing and beat Borges 6-3, 7-6(2).

30-0 all-time in that city.

The Asian swing is on. #tennis #ChinaOpen

article.headline: Djokovic Beats Borges in Beijing, Extends Perfect Record to 30-0 in First Match Since Wimbledon

stories.title: Japan Open Tokyo Opens — Fils Wins Top 10 Debut, Tabilo Upsets Tommy Paul

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
Arthur Fils just won his first match as a Top 10 player. 🎾

6-3, 6-2 over Van Assche at the Japan Open in Tokyo.

Also on Day 1: Tabilo dismantled Tommy Paul 6-1, 6-2.

Two ATP 500s running this week. Asian swing is wide open. #JapanOpen #tennis

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
The ATP has two 500s running simultaneously this week:

🇨🇳 China Open — Djokovic, Zverev, Medvedev, Rublev
🇯🇵 Japan Open — Alcaraz (defending), Fils, Tabilo

Different draws. Same Asian swing points race.

It's a good week for tennis. #tennis #ATP

stories.title: Sinner Shanghai Now in Doubt — Five Events and Counting

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
Sinner now "unlikely to play Shanghai," per Italian media.

The injury has been identified as iliotibial band syndrome. Conservative treatment ongoing; surgery remains a last resort.

His last match was Wimbledon. That's approaching 90 days. #Sinner #tennis
